verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an Agent testing feature that verifies conversational responses, tool usage, and full multi-turn outcomes before deployment, plus converting real conversation transcripts into test cases when an agent underperforms, and a separate agent-analysis system with success evaluation criteria for scoring conversation quality/goal achievement. This directly matches the story of simulating/evaluating conversations before real phone deployment. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the testing workflow's fidelity and no detail on how simulated calls differ from live telephony testing.
